---
title: "Flags: Color and Shape"
format: html
---

Choose a flag, then compare it with others. The comparison samples each flag
on a small grid and measures the difference in color at matching positions.
It also includes a small penalty for differences in aspect ratio (width divided
by height). Lower distances mean closer matches; this is a simple visual
approximation, not a measure of cultural or historical similarity.

```{r}
#| echo: false
flag_codes <- list.files("w2560", pattern = "\\.png$")
ojs_define(flag_codes = sub("\\.png$", "", flag_codes))
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
regionNames = new Intl.DisplayNames(["en"], { type: "region" })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
flagLabel = code => {
  const fallback = code.toUpperCase()
  try {
    return regionNames.of(fallback) || fallback
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof RangeError) return fallback
    throw error
  }
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof selectedCode = Inputs.select(flag_codes, {
  label: "Choose a flag",
  value: "us",
  format: flagLabel
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
selectedFlag = flagLabel(selectedCode)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<figure class="selected-flag">
  <img src=${`w2560/${selectedCode}.png`} alt="Flag of ${selectedFlag}">
  <figcaption>${selectedFlag} (${selectedCode.toUpperCase()})</figcaption>
</figure>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof matchType = Inputs.radio(["Closest", "Most different"], {
  label: "Find",
  value: "Closest"
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
loadFlag = code => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
  const image = new Image()
  image.onload = () => {
    try {
      const canvas = document.createElement("canvas")
      canvas.width = 24
      canvas.height = 16
      const context = canvas.getContext("2d")
      if (!context) {
        reject(new Error("Could not create a canvas to compare flags"))
        return
      }
      context.drawImage(image, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height)
      const pixels = context.getImageData(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height).data
      const ratio = image.naturalWidth / image.naturalHeight
      image.removeAttribute("src")
      resolve({ code, ratio, pixels })
    } catch (error) {
      reject(error)
    }
  }
  image.onerror = () => reject(new Error(`Could not load ${code}.png`))
  image.src = `w2560/${code}.png`
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
flagFeatures = {
  const features = []
  for (let i = 0; i < flag_codes.length; i += 4) {
    features.push(...await Promise.all(flag_codes.slice(i, i + 4).map(loadFlag)))
  }
  return features
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
colorDistance = (first, second) => {
  let squaredDifference = 0
  for (let i = 0; i < first.pixels.length; i += 4) {
    for (let channel = 0; channel < 3; channel += 1) {
      const difference = first.pixels[i + channel] - second.pixels[i + channel]
      squaredDifference += difference * difference
    }
  }
  const colorSamples = first.pixels.length / 4 * 3
  return Math.sqrt(squaredDifference / colorSamples) / 255
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
referenceFlag = flagFeatures.find(item => item.code === selectedCode)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
rankedMatches = flagFeatures
  .filter(flag => flag.code !== selectedCode)
  .map(flag => {
    const colorDifference = colorDistance(referenceFlag, flag)
    const shapeDifference = Math.abs(Math.log(referenceFlag.ratio / flag.ratio))
    return { ...flag, distance: colorDifference + 0.25 * shapeDifference }
  })
  .sort((a, b) => matchType === "Closest"
    ? a.distance - b.distance
    : b.distance - a.distance)
  .slice(0, 3)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`<div class="flag-grid">
  ${rankedMatches.map(flag => {
    const label = flagLabel(flag.code)
    return html`<figure class="match">
      <img src=${`w2560/${flag.code}.png`} alt="Flag of ${label}">
      <figcaption>
        <strong>${label}</strong>
        <span>Distance: ${flag.distance.toFixed(3)}</span>
      </figcaption>
    </figure>`
  })}
</div>`
```

<style>
.selected-flag {
  margin: 1.5rem 0 2rem;
  text-align: center;
}

.selected-flag img {
  max-width: min(100%, 800px);
  max-height: 360px;
  object-fit: contain;
}

.flag-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr));
  gap: 1rem;
  margin-top: 1rem;
}

.match {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 1rem;
  border: 1px solid #ddd;
  border-radius: 0.5rem;
}

.match img {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 120px;
  object-fit: contain;
}

.match figcaption {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 0.25rem;
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
}
</style>
